description: Welcome to Team TECH AND SPACE! We are tackling the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge to bring the stories of NASA’s discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars to life. Combining AI/ML, data analysis, and visualization, we aim to turn space history into an engaging experience. We are looking for passionate teammates skilled in coding, data science, storytelling, and planetary science (English/Hindi speakers) to join our Chennai squad. Let’s build something stellar together!
